rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent dominant gesture: a compact stepped perimeter mass wrapped around a central court. In all four views the form is legible, with the top view confirming a single mass-void rule rather than colliding solids. The stepped silhouette is coherent enough to support the intended neighborhood-living brief, and the carved courtyard gives the project a meaningful public void. The main weakness is access response: the blue frontage edge is not strongly translated into a clearly aligned opening or threshold, so the street condition feels only moderately active rather than fully resolved. Still, the form can plausibly support the program and its active-ground/public-court invariants, so it passes.
